as_told.title: Dulles brothers funded the rise of the Nazis

plain: The claim is that American money helped bring the Nazis to power in Germany in the 1920s and 1930s. Michels tells it himself, without naming a source. He says a bank called Union Bank funded the Nazis, and that Allen Dulles, he thinks, was part of the financing and was stationed "in Norway or something." The researcher Jason Jorjani goes further on the show. He says Allen Dulles and his brother John Foster Dulles, together with JP Morgan Chase, Rockefeller and Prescott Bush, "funded the rise of the Nazis," though he never mentions Union Bank. A third researcher, Dan Sheehan, names neither the bank nor the brothers and says only that American industrialists wanted Hitler "to establish this kind of fascist government." If it were true, it would mean powerful Americans helped build the regime their country later fought.
